faqItems.q: What happens if it rains or a race day is cancelled?
faqItems.a: If there are no races or the program is suspended due to weather, your usage cost is exactly $0.00 USD. You pay no monthly fee, maintenance or hosting. Our model is 100% shared risk.

faqItems.q: Do I need to buy special hardware or terminals?
faqItems.a: No. BetKit Turf OS is agnostic: it runs on any standard computer with Windows, Linux, Android tablets or iPad. It is compatible with any 58mm or 80mm ESC/POS thermal printer connected via USB or local network.

faqItems.q: How do you settle prizes and bank withholdings?
faqItems.a: The engine automatically calculates the regulatory takeout (organizer withholding) of each racetrack and applies pari-mutuel dividends instantly once the scoreboard is official. Your cash register closes with a consolidated audit report to the cent.

faqItems.q: How long does agency installation take?
faqItems.a: Activating your central account takes less than 10 minutes. Our technical support team guides you via WhatsApp or TeamViewer/AnyDesk to configure thermal printers and get your cashiers enabled in a single afternoon.
